faq: Which themes do you work on?
Any current Shopify theme, including Dawn and other Online Store 2.0 themes, and most paid themes from the Theme Store. For older themes we check first and tell you what is possible before we start.
Will you edit my live theme?
No. We work in a duplicate so your live store is untouched. When you approve the preview we publish it, and your old theme stays in your library as a backup you can go back to.
What if a previous developer customized my theme?
That is fine. We read the existing code first and keep their changes working where we can. If something is hard to change safely, we say so and suggest a cleaner way before we touch it.
One edit is one change in one place, such as a new button color or a moved block. If a change touches many pages, we count it by the area it covers and confirm that in writing before starting.
desc:
Shopify theme customization and edits cover layout changes, bug fixes and new features on the theme you already use. Ecom Swift LLC makes each change in a duplicate copy, tests it on desktop and mobile, and publishes only when you approve.

## What is Shopify theme customization?

Shopify theme customization is the editing of your store's theme files to change how it looks or behaves beyond what the theme editor allows. Themes are built from Liquid templates, sections, snippets, CSS and JavaScript. A customization can be as small as a spacing fix or as large as a new section with its own settings.

Many owners reach the limit of the theme editor quickly. The button is the wrong color on mobile, the announcement bar does not do what is needed, or a section breaks on a certain screen. These are small problems, but they are hard to solve without touching code.

## Why careful theme editing matters

Your theme is the base of every page. A small mistake in a template can break product pages, hide a price or stop the cart from opening. Editing the live theme directly means shoppers see the mistake at once.

Old customizations make this worse. When several developers have added snippets over the years, or apps have left code behind, one edit can interact with something nobody remembers. A cautious approach, working on a copy and testing each change, keeps your live store safe.

## How theme edits affect results

Theme work does not sell anything alone, but it removes friction and gaps. A size guide at the right spot answers a question before the shopper leaves. A fixed mobile menu helps visitors find products. A custom section lets you launch a campaign page without paying a developer each time, because you can edit it yourself in the theme editor.

The mechanism is simple: every broken, awkward or missing detail costs some attention, and fixing details adds up across all visitors. The exact effect varies with your store, so we focus on getting each change right and tested.

## What good theme work includes

- Text, color, spacing and font changes that match your brand.
- Mobile layout fixes for menus, galleries and product pages.
- Repairs for features that stopped working after an update or an app change.
- Header, footer and menu changes, such as a mega menu or an announcement bar.
- Custom sections with settings you can edit in the theme editor, without touching code.
- Product page features like a size guide, tabs, icons or extra information blocks.
- Clean code that follows the structure of your theme.
- Cleanup of leftover code from apps you removed.
- A tested duplicate theme, and a backup of the current one.
- A written list of what we changed.

## How we work

You send a list of changes. We read it, ask questions where something is unclear and confirm what counts as one edit before starting. We then duplicate your theme and make the changes in the copy. We test each change on desktop and on several mobile sizes, and we check the cart and checkout so nothing else was affected.

When you approve a private preview, we publish the edited theme. The Basic package covers small changes to text, color, spacing and mobile layout. The Standard package adds more edits, new custom sections and fixes for broken features. The Premium package adds larger work such as custom product page features, cleanup of old app code and a backup of the theme, with follow-up fixes after launch. If a previous developer left heavily customized code, we tell you what we find before we promise to change it.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Describe each change with a page address and a screenshot.
- Tell us which devices and browsers matter most.
- Keep the original theme as a backup.
- Group related changes in one request.
- Approve the preview before we publish.

**Avoid:**
- Editing the live theme while shoppers are browsing.
- Pasting code snippets from forums without knowing what they do.
- Asking for changes that conflict with each other.
- Installing a new app to do what a few lines of code can do.
- Skipping a test order after the changes.

## Who this is for

This service suits store owners with a long list of small fixes, merchants whose theme broke after an update or app install, and brands that need a custom section for a campaign or a product launch. It also suits owners who inherited a heavily edited theme and need someone to make sense of it.

## What we need from you

Send us your store address, your list of changes and screenshots or examples where you can. Please invite us to your store as a staff or collaborator user, with permission to edit themes. We never ask for a password. If your theme was built by a previous developer, tell us who and when, so we know what to look for.
